title: Supervision-drift audit protocol for proxy-labeled credit-risk prediction (code and locked protocol)
description: Code, locked design and analysis protocol, decision rules, run manifests, and result tables for the HICSS-60 paper "A Decision-Support Audit Protocol for Supervision Drift in Proxy-Labeled Credit-Risk Prediction" (Shoeibi, Shabanpour, Karwowski, and Yousefi). The pipeline implements the five diagnostic layers (transfer performance, oracle gap, calibration, feature-label stability, synthetic positive control) and the rule-based multi-signal synthesis on the public LendingClub loan-granting dataset (Ariza-Garzon et al., 2024, doi:10.5281/zenodo.11295916). The raw data are not included.
